member_findings.title: Avoid buffering unused ping output
member_findings.impact: Every call stores stdout and stderr in memory even though the helper only checks the return code. With a large count or a noisy ping implementation, this does unnecessary allocation and copy work on an operator path.
member_findings.fix: Redirect stdout and stderr to subprocess.DEVNULL, and consider bounding count to a small operationally useful maximum if this helper can be called from loops or automation.
